# eslint-plugin-modularity

Guide for AI coding assistants using this plugin in a project. To change the plugin's own source, read https://github.com/ofri-peretz/eslint/blob/main/AGENTS.md instead.

> ESLint module boundaries and architecture rules — enforces DDD value objects and anemic-model checks, naming, REST conventions, and utility isolation.

## Enable it

```bash
npm install --save-dev eslint-plugin-modularity
```

Requires ESLint ^8.40.0 || ^9.0.0 || ^10.0.0 and Node >=22.13.0.

```js
// eslint.config.mjs
import modularity from 'eslint-plugin-modularity';

export default [modularity.configs.recommended];
```

Each preset is one flat config object: put it in the array as an element, do not spread it. Rule ids are prefixed `modularity/`. Add it to the config you already have; do not remove other plugins. TypeScript files need a TypeScript parser in the config (`typescript-eslint`).

## Presets

| Preset        | Rules | Errors | Warnings |
| ------------- | ----- | ------ | -------- |
| `recommended` | 6     | 3      | 3        |
| `strict`      | 6     | 6      | 0        |

### `recommended`

6 rules:

- `ddd-anemic-domain-model` (warn): Detects entities with only getters/setters and no business logic.
- `ddd-value-object-immutability` (error): Validates value objects are properly immutable.
- `enforce-naming` (warn): Enforce domain-specific naming conventions with business context.
- `enforce-rest-conventions` (error): Validates REST endpoint design against best practices.
- `no-external-api-calls-in-utils` (error): Detects network calls in utility functions.
- `no-mutable-exports` (warn): Disallow mutable exports (export let / export var).

### `strict`

Same rules as `recommended`.
